info.title: Positivity Work Order API
info.description: Comprehensive API for managing estimates, work orders, change requests, and approval configurations. Supports signature capture, purchase order enforcement, state machine workflows, and emergency overrides.

servers.description: API Gateway endpoint for work order services

tags.name: Work Order API
tags.description: Operations for managing work orders including lifecycle state transitions, approvals, completions, and history tracking

tags.name: Estimate API
tags.description: Operations for managing estimates including creation, approval with signature capture, decline/reopen workflows, and purchase order enforcement

tags.name: Change Request API
tags.description: Operations for managing change requests during work order execution including technician requests, advisor approvals, emergency overrides, and pre-close validations

tags.name: Approval Configuration API
tags.description: Operations for managing approval configurations with hierarchical resolution by location and customer

get.description: Retrieve a list of all work orders in the system

200.description: List of work orders retrieved successfully

post.description: Create a new work order from an approved estimate. Workorder starts in DRAFT state.

get.description: Retrieve a specific work order by its unique identifier

delete.description: Delete a work order by its unique identifier. Only work orders in DRAFT state can be deleted.

parameters.name: workorderId
parameters.description: UUID of the work order to delete

400.description: Cannot delete workorder in current state

post.description: Transition work order from DRAFT to WORK_IN_PROGRESS state. Records the user and reason for starting work.

parameters.name: workorderId
parameters.description: UUID of the work order to start

get.description: Retrieve the complete history of state transitions for a work order
Retrieve the complete history of workorder snapshots for temporal queries

post.description: Approve a work order with customer signature. Supports base64-encoded signature capture and line item-level approval/rejection.

parameters.name: workorderId
parameters.description: UUID of the work order to approve

post.description: Mark a work order as completed. Validates all required approvals and change request acknowledgments.

parameters.name: workorderId
parameters.description: UUID of the work order to complete

get.description: Retrieve a list of all estimates in the system

post.description: Create a new estimate in DRAFT state. Requires ESTIMATE_CREATE permission.

get.description: Retrieve a specific estimate by its unique identifier
Retrieve all estimates for a specific customer
Retrieve all estimates for a specific shop location
Retrieve all estimates for a specific location

post.description: Decline an estimate. The estimate can be reopened within the configured expiry period.

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: UUID of the estimate to decline

400.description: Cannot decline estimate in current state

post.description: Reopen a declined estimate if still within the configured expiry period.

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: UUID of the estimate to reopen

400.description: Cannot reopen estimate - expiry period exceeded or invalid state

post.description: Approve an estimate with customer signature. Supports base64-encoded signature capture, line item-level approval/rejection, and purchase order enforcement (CAP:092 Story #98). For commercial accounts with PO enforcement enabled, purchaseOrderNumber is required.

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: UUID of the estimate to approve

400.description: Invalid approval request or missing PO number

get.description: Retrieve all change requests associated with a work order

post.description: Create a new change request for additional work discovered during workorder execution. Technicians can flag items as emergency/safety-critical.

get.description: Retrieve a specific change request by its unique identifier

post.description: Advisor approves a change request, transitioning it from PENDING_APPROVAL to READY_TO_EXECUTE state

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: UUID of the change request to approve

post.description: Advisor declines a change request, transitioning it from PENDING_APPROVAL to CANCELLED state. Emergency/safety items require customer acknowledgment of denial.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: UUID of the change request to decline

post.description: Record customer acknowledgment of a declined emergency/safety item. Required before workorder can be closed if emergency items were declined.

400.description: Invalid request - not an emergency item or not declined

post.description: Manager applies emergency override to immediately approve a change request. Requires Manager role.

get.summary: Check if workorder can be closed
get.description: Validate whether a workorder can be closed. Checks for unacknowledged emergency item denials.

canClose.description: Whether the workorder can be closed

get.description: Retrieve a list of all approval configurations

200.description: List of approval configurations retrieved successfully

post.description: Create a new approval configuration. Supports location and customer-specific settings with hierarchical priority.

get.description: Retrieve a specific approval configuration by its unique identifier

parameters.name: approvalId
parameters.description: UUID of the approval configuration to delete

get.description: Get the most specific approval configuration using hierarchical resolution. Priority order: customer+location > location-only > customer-only > default.
